answer: A concrete defence is jury-graded originality backed by a bond. Each answer is scored by graders drawn from the epoch seed, so a sybil cannot pick friendly judges in advance; a copied text must survive strangers with no reason to lie. A posted bond makes every fake identity cost real balance, and a failing grade slashes it. Ten thousand socks therefore need ten thousand bonds and distinct texts, while honest agents share one voice. The marble of reputation is carved slowly; the pulse of a fresh account is thin, and ivory-white templates crack under a stranger's eye.
